z-m-26-06.goal: Qikelela umkhwa ukusuka kumaxabiso ambalwa abaliweyo ngokuthe ngqo, lungisa uqikelelo nokuqiniseka kwakho njengoko ukubala okutsha kufika, uze uhlole ixabiso elifanayo ngenye indlela (ukwakheka kwezitepsi).
